breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero by symmetry, but for a simply supported beam under a midspan point load the slope is zero at midspan, not at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states that the slope is zero at midspan (due to symmetry), not at the supports. It explicitly says 'Apply the symmetry condition that the slope is zero at the midspan,' which aligns with the ground truth and corrects the original error of claiming slope vanishes at the supports.
